materialChanges: Changed the clinical synthesis to claims-mapped, linked all eight applicable claims, added the complete learner-visible source note, and replaced the person-reading repeatability shortcut with stable control/reference material or suitable same-specimen replicates under named conditions.

Narrowed the construct-validity objective to the boundary-setting and evidence-selection performance actually assessed, strengthened the greenhouse validity criterion, and made the relevant construct-validity and bounded-conclusion criteria mandatory for mastery.
Corrected the lesson version stated in ATTRIBUTION.md from 0.1.0 to 0.2.0.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The clinical wrap-up is now claims-mapped in lesson.json, all eight applicable claim records include scene-clinical-wrap-up, and the scene ends with a source note naming every mapped claim and all four supporting sources. The retained example stays within those measurement propositions and makes no empirical patient or treatment claim.

The final scene now bases analytic repeatability on stable control/reference material or suitable aliquots of the same specimen over a justified short interval with relevant operating conditions fixed. It states that sequential person readings can mix measurand change with measurement error and frames cross-system reproducibility around the same or similar stable material with changed conditions named.

The objective was narrowed from requiring judgment across six named evidence categories to the critique, boundary-setting, and evidence-selection performance present in the assessment. The greenhouse validity criterion now requires both an omitted aspect and a construct-irrelevant influence, and mastery specifically requires the construct-validity criteria plus the greenhouse bounded conclusion.
The independently confirmed means, ranges, offsets, percentage offset, and keyed scatter-versus-shift interpretations were unchanged.
ATTRIBUTION.md now identifies the pack as version 0.2.0, matching lesson.json and every structured lesson artifact.

The final clinical wrap-up remains an explicitly fictional, non-treatment synthesis of operational definitions, error, named repeatability/reproducibility conditions, and construct-validity boundaries. The technical corrections required by the academic review preserve those learning-design strengths.

The complete worked example, faded practice sequence, team-coordination transfer, and greenhouse transfer assessment were preserved. Only the mastery alignment for the narrowed construct-validity objective was tightened.

evidenceChecked: Read all seven final scene files in manifest order: each has one level-one heading, semantic source order, ordinary Markdown structure, and no raw HTML, HTML entities, or Markdown images.

Checked that the local declarative concept-map JSON has concise alt text and a relationship-complete long description, while the same audit sequence is also available in ordered prose and does not depend on color or position.
Checked that the error equation is read in words and that each quantitative table is followed by a prose interpretation of the relevant means, ranges, scatter, and shift.

Checked that prompts and assessment responses have untimed, retakeable, keyboard-compatible text routes; typed, dictated, prose, heading, and table response forms are allowed, with retry and recovery guidance.

Checked that the pack contains no active media, remote embed, executable content, third-party asset, personal record, patient record, or required health data; all cases and numerical records are labelled fictional.

Checked all four source records for allowed source types, bounded bibliographic fields, ISO dates, facts-only use, concrete rights-basis evidence, and checked-no-agent-restriction-found access status; no source is marked human-only.
Checked lesson.json, ATTRIBUTION.md, the original diagram declaration, CC BY 4.0 grant, empty thirdPartyAssets list, accountable principal, and disclosed authoring-agent provenance.
limitations: No browser renderer, screen reader, 200% zoom/reflow, print, or export adapter was exercised because the assigned scope excluded site and npm operations; this was a source-level accessibility audit.
Live source terms and source content were not re-fetched in this run; the audit used the dated same-pack access records and the academic review's evidence record.

Repository schema validation, strict source preflight, and full npm validation were not run because the operator expressly prohibited site access and npm. Only JSON parsing and scoped structural, content, reference-field, and provenance checks were run.

The pull-request COMMENTED submissions were not independently queried; review-input transport eligibility relies on the operator-supplied context and remains subject to the repository's GitHub-provenance check.

rationale: The two counted artifacts address the exact original candidate and version, supply the required academic and learning-design roles, contain one approval and one eligible advisory request for changes, and disclose distinct agent runs and providers under one accountable principal. Their GitHub COMMENTED transport status is operator-supplied rather than independently queried here. Every indexed finding has a disposition: the three academic blockers and the attribution mismatch were incorporated, while the verified calculations and positive learning-design observations required no further change. The final source now closes the clinical claim-evidence gap, removes the false repeatability shortcut, and aligns construct-validity mastery with the narrowed objective. The source-level accessibility-and-rights audit found equivalent prose paths, non-timed and non-pointer response routes, facts-only source use, complete attribution, no third-party assets, and no privacy or active-content concern. Subject to replacement of the pending final commit, runtime stamping, and the required repository checks, no credible unresolved content, accessibility, or rights blocker remains.
dissent: The academic reviewer requested changes while the learning-design reviewer approved the original candidate and described the clinical synthesis positively. The academic measurement-science objections controlled the technical revision; the learning-design strengths were preserved.

The learning-design review discloses that github:VSBDev operated authoring and review runs during the founding stage. The distinct-run and distinct-provider declarations are attested provenance, not independently verified human review.
Neither review supplies real learner-performance data, so the decision concerns lesson coherence and defensibility rather than demonstrated learning effectiveness.
